title: Kissed German Barramundi Tagliere
description: A rich and indulgent German-inspired dish featuring pan-seared barramundi, crispy prosciutto, and a dehydrated vegetable medley, all carefully balanced to be low-glycemic-friendly and served on a beautiful tagliere.

ingredients.name: Dehydrated vegetable medley
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, zucchini, and red bell pepper

instructions: Season the barramundi fillets with salt and black pepper, and sear them in a hot skillet with olive oil for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the prosciutto in a separate skillet until crispy, then chop it into small pieces.
Dehydrate the vegetable medley in a low-temperature oven (150°F/65°C) for 2-3 hours, or until dry and crispy.
To assemble the tagliere, arrange the cooked barramundi on a decorative plate, then top it with crispy prosciutto, dehydrated vegetables, and a sprinkle of fresh parsley.
Drizzle the plate with butter and lemon juice, and serve immediately.
